independence: New to this project's comparisons, and not used to change force-field or flow parameters. Values were visible during implementation, so this is not a blinded model-selection holdout. Future changes informed by these results would make these data development evidence.

sources.status: Included: three near-25 C rows, all rows within 0.3 K of the 298.15 K thermostat
sources.visual_check: PDF pages 6 and 7: table values and reference calibrations verified against rendered tables.
sources.limitations: Relative capillary measurements in helium. Absolute tensions use IAPWS reference values; independent campaign, but not independent absolute calibration. Article reports absolute uncertainty about 0.36-0.41 mN/m; plots show a conservative 0.4 mN/m band, not a new precision estimate. The three rows are not three separate studies. Temperature differs by 0.22-0.23 K; actual MD temperature is reported separately. No direct experimental psi populations.

sources.status: Included: reported actual DVS and PARSIVEL velocities for nominal 2.5 mm drops, not correlation-based ground truth
sources.visual_check: PDF pages 10 and 11: Figures 6-7 support the reported velocity regions; Table 3 gives DVS combined uncertainty. Figure 7 velocity axis mistakenly says mm. Figure 6 has quantized individual velocities; 7.8 is the approximate value in prose, not a reconstructed exact mean.
sources.limitations: Measured 2.5 mm diameter is mass-derived nominal size, not a resolved time-dependent shape. DVS N=27; PARSIVEL N=149 in a different stairwell with wind. Table 3 nominal diameter uncertainty 0.05 mm; DVS combined velocity uncertainty 0.5 m/s is not divided by sqrt(N). No exact ambient air properties, interface shape or local air velocity supplied for matching these calculations. Earlier general prose says slight underestimation; Section 4.1 specifically reports large-drop overestimation and Figure 6 supports the latter. Quoted GT 7.4 m/s is model-derived and is excluded as a measured target.

sources.status: Qualitative wake context only; excluded from numerical frequency validation
sources.reason: Wake images and drop shapes are observations. Table frequencies and Strouhal numbers are inferred from correlations; they are not measured shedding frequencies. One-plane images do not validate our three-dimensional vortex statistics.

Full hydrogen-bond graph, shortest graph distance exactly four, minimum O-O distance over that shell; missing shell remains unclassified. Our planar depth groups are not the paper's ITIM intrinsic layers.

sources.status: Fixed water model and parameter benchmark
sources.reason: Original rigid molecular geometry and charges/LJ parameters, PME plus LJPME. TIP4P/2005 was selected before this turn. Its historic calibration is not independent evidence for every water property.

Constant-volume, rigid-molecule area perturbation; our molecular centers are translated while geometry is preserved. Two interfaces explicitly give dF/dA=2 gamma. Finite area strain, box size and sampling are tested. 3D periodic PME images remain a limitation.

sources.status: Numerical method; not a drop experiment
sources.reason: Second-order nonequilibrium stress regularization. Our fixed Cs=0.1 subgrid viscosity, voxel wall and inlet/outlet are explicit approximations; this is not DNS or a liquid free-boundary solver.
